'''Tahm''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Empire]] who fought during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the early days of the [[Galactic War]]. Tahm wore armored robes and a neck guard while wielding his [[purple]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] into combat. The Sith Lord was an accomplished [[Sith sorcerer]], and made great use of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and life-draining [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] in combat.<ref name="Tahm" />

Tahm took on at least two [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]; the [[Sith Warrior]] [[Mace (Sith apprentice)|Mace]]<ref name="Mace" /> and the [[Sith assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Harp'r]].<ref name="Harp'r" /> In [[3642 BBY]], he and his two apprentices fought during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] on the [[Sundari Flatlands]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] forces.<ref name="Tahm" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tahm appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an antagonist on the planet Balmorra, where he can be found along with Apprentice Mace and Apprentice Harp'r in the Sundari Flatlands region.<ref name="Tahm" />
